gen-dafont-ostrich-sans-fs-karma: Tall, slim and tightly packed. Ostrich Sans glows like neon tubing up top, while Karma, a text serif with thinner hairlines, stays gentle and unhurried below.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-ranade: Outrun Future draws every stroke as one constant outline with wide spacing and a large x-height, no thick-to-thin shading at all. Ranade loosens that rigidity.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-graduate: Outrun Future spreads wide, a constant-width outline with a large x-height and short ascenders, looking like a synthwave sign. Graduate's serif letters feel dignified and bookish over time.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-savate: Savate reads contemporary and clean, with open jaws on every curve. Beneath the tubular, copper-pipe strokes of Outrun Future, its gently tapered glass-rod weight gives the page a lighter, softer second voice.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-outfit: Authoritative, wide and unmistakably synthwave. Outrun Future carries a high lowercase, and Outfit follows in a moderate one, its cable-like sans strokes staying smooth and approachable underneath.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-work-sans: Work Sans has a high mean line and c tips that never creep toward touching. Over a longer passage, Work Sans stays modern and easy under Outrun Future's wide, authoritative lettering.
gen-dafont-over-there-author: Commanding, vintage-military lettering from Over There, drawn as if by a fixed-width nib. Author, a text serif with a slight swell on its bowls, would read as refined and dignified across a longer passage.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-synonym: Synonym draws a plain stripe of constant ink with generous curve openings. Over There keeps its wide, commanding military feel, so give Synonym a little extra size to hold its own.
gen-dafont-over-there-space-grotesk: Neutral, geometric Space Grotesk forms each glyph as a ribbon of constant width, with counters that breathe wide open. Over There, vintage and commanding, sits above; a slightly larger body size helps.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-domine: Stencil-cut, geometric, and wide in the curves. Ozone leads in one steady width, while Domine's text serif arches thin slightly at the stem, giving the pair a refined, dignified quality.
